query, grade definitions, labeled examples
programs (we use k=3k=3), written independently from the same prompt. Each program returns four answers per document: on_subject, some_answer, exact_answer, dedicated.
Run the programs on a CPU, without model calls. Grade per program: 0 if not on subject; 1 if no answer; 3 if exact and dedicated; 2 otherwise.

One writer call per program and topic. The programs then grade any number of documents.
∙\bullet The rules behind each grade are code that people can read.
∙\bullet ExecJudges-L adds a few labeled passages of the topic to the writer prompt.
